liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Called the best Shakedown Street of 1993; Called a strong opener [8][13][14]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (3 reviews): Possibly one of the best versions the band ever played; Garcia's solo is among his best ever, though Bobby's voice was too worn [8][13][14]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (3 reviews): Fire emerging from Picasso Moon is singled out as outstanding; Fire is called outstanding [10][11][16]
- **Cassidy** (2 reviews): Cassidy into Uncle John's Band and back to Cassidy is a sequence the reviewer wished was played more often; The move from Cassidy into Uncle John's Band was unimpressive, but returning to Cassidy was much smoother [11][17]
- **The Same Thing** (1 review): Described with slinky slide guitar and tinkling piano [14]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer says it is riddled with mistakes and nearly unlistenable [16]

## The recordings

- **gd93-05-27.sbd.miller.27777.sbeok.flac** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 3.83/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass is thumping and resonant, especially with the volume turned up [12]
- **gd1993-05-27.fob.schoeps.gems.100800.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 170 min [4]. Said about its sound: After correction, the tape has lush space between instruments and Phil's bass is well represented; among the best 1993 audience tapes [4]
- **gd93-05-27.sbd.georges.1932.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 159 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer docks the show to three stars solely because of the recording quality; Mix has instruments too low and recording level too high; sounds pleasing when played at low volume; Described as a nice-sounding soundboard [7][9][11][16]
- **gd1993-05-27.109587.sankens.fob.bernstein.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls the Sacramento venue sentimental [10]
- Recommended as an alternative for fans of the 9-22 show with David Murray, who don't want to overplay it [7]
- Rated slightly above the previous night and equal to 9-22 as the year's best show [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-05-27.sbd.miller.27777.sbeok.flac**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD> Dat (48k); [1]. Also: This Miller soundboard source is noticeably better than the earlier, most widely circulated version [12]
- **gd1993-05-27.fob.schoeps.gems.100800.flac16**: transferred by Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell; source: Schoeps Mk2 Omni Capsules in-hat human mic stands spaced 8' apart -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC Mic Body -> Oade Mic Pre -> Panasonic sv255 [4]. Also: Schoeps spaced omni front-of-board DAT had out-of-phase mics; phase adjustment and remastering fixed the cancellation; A small patch in Fire On The Mountain was taken from Keith Litzenberger's OTS recording [4]
- **gd93-05-27.sbd.georges.1932.sbeok.shnf**: source: M:C> D> transfer via dap1>zoltrix nightengale> SHN [6]
- **gd1993-05-27.109587.sankens.fob.bernstein.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: Sankens COS1 FOB -> ? -> DAT (16 bit/48 khz); [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1993-05-27 Thu Cal Expo Amphitheatre, Sacramento, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1377822306566/grateful-dead-1993-05-27-thu-cal-expo) [20]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-05-26 Cal Expo, Sacramento, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-05-26-cal-expo-sacramento-ca-usa/) [21]
